![Find Rare and Out of Print Books at the Best Used Bookstores in NYC - Capitalize My Title](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/D5CLr3OjRcE2uHKS19Lzkhmh9jVvUIqeVospBE5zM9svC0iTyvVz6u4l0OOmHPcnttvUFTuIefMCx95XKj44G5SBvfOF54Xz_jL_jDidAw4k4FW49HVRmDXg3TYDz4tqxOvgU2BiArxe-JuM6njocYuDktIVCknuKSxidncBWf88TvzfftVAbE8r_3XG0pyw?purpose=fullsize)

## National auction houses

If you have particularly valuable first editions, consider getting an estimate from these auction houses before accepting a dealer's offer.

![US-ART-AUCTION-RELIGION](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/X7PnPA-R6xxO8PHUoGF5bGv4-Bn9PdSFblXZdhQVfn-pXe7Z7sjoNe0XyjqRtfjB1A_gBXdrexqHlfwna4MyTJ6Pi4DTW-dW7HhNQnfaRXAzBReQD_F7NFvOmne1YfAJBrax0mzYSiU8YTntQzSjEB-XjnzAgVOqUAXtZv1rr4o6uwGY6YRxLJpU_7FBib-u?purpose=fullsize)

**Sotheby's**

Offers complimentary preliminary estimates for rare books and collections.

[Submit books to Sotheby's](https://www.sothebys.com/en/sell/books?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

![Going Once! 11 World-Class Auctioneers Tell Us the Stories and Strange Rituals Behind Their Luckiest Gavels](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hMDwbqwznABm-yJyjviuCPbtpiS6jjxbUvqdEEW7hSwborbHenf_VXI56kzR3zDfAmsvbwqXsWcliaMfRoQsdURHxLsJacdyeD6h87rzViBDdwCygzlyHkHRi_FkR4Vihp_nlV7jhdYnKJ13-KmG5C1tfN0CcFBVecblQh50Rg71lqXNBy4xxTMYG1wcKkFT?purpose=fullsize)

**Christie's**

Specializes in rare books, manuscripts and important literary works.

[Request a free estimate](https://www.christies.com/en/selling-guide/rare-books?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Online selling options

- [eBay](https://www.ebay.com/) – Good for selling individual collectible books directly.
- [AbeBooks](https://www.abebooks.com/) – Marketplace specializing in rare and collectible books.
- [Biblio](https://www.biblio.com/) – Another marketplace for antiquarian and collectible books.

## How to get the best price

Before selling\:

1. Confirm that the book is genuinely a first edition and, ideally, first printing.
2. Check whether it has its original dust jacket.
3. Look for an author's signature or inscription.
4. Compare actual sold prices, not just asking prices.
5. Get at least two or three offers before accepting.

---

## Let me help identify the best buyer for your books.

I have three questions\:

1. **What authors or titles do you have?** For example, Hemingway, F. Scott Fitzgerald, Stephen King, Tolkien, Dickens, etc.
2. **Are they signed by the authors?**
3. **Approximately how many books are you selling?** One or two, 5–20, or an entire collection?

You can also upload photographs of the books.

I can help identify which ones might be valuable, estimate potential resale values, and narrow down the best places to sell them.
